question: Who among the following was voted the ICC player of the Month for February 2022 in Men's category?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shreyas Iyer.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Shreyas Santosh Iyer is an Indian cricketer who plays for the national side in international cricket, Mumbai in domestic cricket, and captains Kolkata Knight Riders in the Indian Premier League
 
• He was voted for the Men's category for the ICC player of the Month for February 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Vriitya Aravind is an Emirati cricketer who plays as a wicket-keeper batsman for the United Arab Emirates cricket team. In October 2019, he was added to the UAE's squad for the 2019 ICC T20 World Cup Qualifier tournament, replacing Ghulam Shabber.
 
• Dependra Singh Airee is a Nepalese cricketer. In August 2018, he was one of the eleven cricketers to play in Nepal's first-ever One Day International match, against the Netherlands
 
• Virat Kohli is an Indian international cricketer and former captain of the Indian national cricket team. He plays for Delhi in domestic cricket and Royal Challengers Bangalore.
